name: viperlegacy2-facebook-bot-repo
description: Playbook + Playwright wrapper for the ViperLegacy Facebook parts bot agent. Read-only: scrapes Viper FB groups hourly, classifies parts being searched/sold/located, indexes findings by generation + part.
comment: All deps are also pre-installed globally inside the worker_v1-playwright:0.1.4+ image. Declaring them locally is defense-in-depth for hosts on older image tags or stock Node setups.
